completed_work_packages.title: Persistent Session/Message Store, Bounded ContextAssembler, Non-Parametric Alias Learning & BR-15 Taint Propagation
highlights: Reuses core.db session/message tables when conversation_history_retention_enabled=True (volatile RAM otherwise) and reloads persisted context across container restarts.
retrieve_relevant_memories and upsert_user_alias query is_encrypted=0 directly, avoiding unnecessary decryption of unrelated sensitive encrypted rows.
Exposes GET /v1/memories/inspector with memory influence provenance, user aliases, and session_untrusted_taint state.
Propagates BR-15 untrusted taint across turns so LLM-proposed mutating actions after RAG/screen exposure inherit untrusted_origin=True and are denied (403 DENIED).

completed_work_packages.title: Strict Per-Tool Pydantic Schemas, Bounded LLM Repair Loop, Compound Multi-Step Coordinator & Tier-2 GUI Diff File Edit/Move
highlights: Strict extra='forbid' Pydantic v2 schemas for all registered tools eliminate KeyError 500s on malformed LLM arguments.
Up to 2 bounded LLM schema repair attempts before deterministic 422 INVALID_ARGS.
Anchored _VOLUME_SET_RE and added _COMPOUND_MULTI_ACTION_RE so multi-action utterances escalate to Multi-Step Coordinator with honest PARTIAL outcome on independent NOT_FOUND.

Delivered POST /v1/files/edit/propose|apply and re-enabled POST /v1/files/move/propose|apply (Decision A2) with unified diff preview, anti-empty-truncate guard, single-use GUI approval_id consume, TOCTOU TARGET_CHANGED verification, no-overwrite guard, atomic fsync+replace write, and SHA-256 readback.

completed_work_packages.title: Real Persistent Background Reminder Scheduler, Non-Shell Win32 Toast Notifications & Real Declarative Workflow Executor
highlights: BackgroundSchedulerRunner runs periodic non-blocking SQLite reminder reconciliation inside FastAPI lifespan (GET /v1/scheduler/status) with idempotent dedup_key delivery across restarts.
WindowsToastNotificationAdapter uses Win32 Shell_NotifyIconW (NIF_INFO) with zero PowerShell/shell invocation and truthful OS acceptance return.

WorkflowEngineService.execute_workflow_async wired to TurnOrchestratorService.execute_verified_step_for_workflow for real policy-checked tool execution while unwired WorkflowEngineService still blocks fake completion with ErrorCode.UNSUPPORTED.

completed_work_packages.title: Hardened Layer-2/3 Hybrid RAG Ingestion & Delimiter Breakout Escaping
highlights: sync_source_root strictly enforces scope_json extensions, skips symlinks/reparse points, and fast-skips unchanged files using mtime_ns + byte_size before hashing/parsing.

completed_work_packages.title: Honest Protected Screen Awareness with Title+Text Secret Redaction & Win32 UAC/Password Guards
highlights: Redacts secrets from BOTH window_title and extracted_text before model/UI/audit output and exposes honest capability_kind ('window_metadata'|'uia_text'|'ocr').
Real Win32 OpenProcessToken + GetTokenInformation(TokenElevation=20) fail-closed elevation check and GetGUIThreadInfo/ES_PASSWORD password-field check verified via live read-only Windows host probe.
